# Soonkit

> An open-source coming soon page with a paper-flip countdown and a live visual editor.

This file is for language models. Prefer it over scraping the README.

## Product

Soonkit is a static Vite + React site. Users brand it by editing `public/soon.config.json` or by using the on-page Customize panel. There is no backend.

Repo: https://github.com/auviel/soonkit
License: MIT

## Agent rules

1. Edit `public/soon.config.json` for brand, copy, colors, fonts, launch date, and SEO.
2. Set `editor` to `false` before a public launch.
3. Do not rewrite the flip-clock component unless asked.
4. Dev: `npm install` && `npm run dev` (port 5173).
5. Build: `npm run build` → `dist/`.
6. Deploy `dist/` to Vercel, Netlify, Cloudflare Pages, or GitHub Pages.
7. Default deploy if unspecified: `npx vercel --yes --prod`.

## Config schema

See `src/config/types.ts`. Top-level keys: `brand`, `copy`, `launchAt`, `showCountdown`, `showEmail`, `editor`, `seo`, `theme`, `fonts`.

`launchAt` is ISO-8601. Empty `brand.logo` renders a text wordmark.

## Prompts

Ready-to-paste prompts live in `prompts/`. Start with `prompts/starter.md`.
Full agent instructions: `AGENTS.md`.
